notes: Standalone cdf_study (ADR-0190 stages) for the pooled per-ticker-heads model over NVDA, META, TSLA, MU, MSTR. Built from the workflow's expanded step-6 config of the top5-opt NVDA lane. Run from children/index_options: python -m index_options.cdf_study configs/run-pooled-heads-top5.json --stage search --partition <each of experiment.search_partitions>, then --stage select, --stage evaluate --partition development, --stage evaluate --partition later, --stage report (env CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8, OMP/OPENBLAS threads 1). Folds: configs/run-pooled-heads-top5-folds.json.

data.notes: Five stocks pooled in one study. exact_dte 31 = the pooled argmax DTE over the five tickers' pulled option-trade bars (scratchpad memo_counts.json: 76,870 of 688,084 bars at DTE 31; ties to the shorter DTE; the pull covered DTE 30-45 only), set by hand from the pooled argmax because no value_from hook exists. Full price history (window end only, stocks-opt.json's end) so the long history is the warm-up; option-trade features exist only from 2024-01-19 and are missing (with *_missing flags, median-imputed by the study) before. Reader, columns, corporate actions and keyed tables as stocks-opt.json / stocks-*-features.json.

fold_table.notes: From run-pooled-heads-top5-folds.json: one expanding warm-up fold before the options window, nine expanding scored folds inside it; holdout from 2026-01-30 never evaluated.

study.notes: Folds come from step 3's fold table (ADR-0222/0223), which carries date boundaries and complete-case counts only: the study slices every panel row inside a fold's boundaries and median-imputes the dates missing an admitted family (about 8% of QQQ dev dates), so training is NOT complete-case. Owner decision 2026-10-02 (option A): median imputation is ACCEPTED and no complete-case filter will be built. Warm-up folds for search, selection and the development evaluation; scored folds only for the frozen 'later' evaluation; the holdout is refused by the study. cal_n = 40 dates (one validation window) is the inner slice of each training window used ONLY for patience early stopping (never the scored window). Replace path/sha256/holdout_start with the values printed by the step-3 run for this ticker/source/expiry. Baselines: horizon_empirical = the historical (empirical) return CDF fitted on each fold's training rows (signal = beat it); option_proxy_transport = the option-implied CDF from the entry chain's rn_q quantiles (market edge = beat it).

experiment.notes: Pooled per-ticker-heads HPO (owner design 2026-10-03). MLP candidates: MixtureMLPCDF, pooled true (one fit on all five tickers' fold rows), head_features = the is_<T> one-hot positions (shared trunk, one mixture head per ticker); MixtureMLPCDF trains by likelihood (NLL), not TorchCDF's 0.1 NLL + wing twCRPS, because TorchCDF refuses heads. GRU candidates: TorchCDF, pooled true, with is_<T> as plain context inputs (TorchCDF refuses head_features). Grids mirror workflow args.hpo (hidden x learning_rate; GRU hidden_size 16, head [32,16]). Two feature groups per architecture: base = the 38-name core every per-ticker run kept plus the 4 volume_liquidity names; options = base plus the 7 option-trade features and their _missing flags. Selection and the acceptance intervals use plain CRPS; tail_crps is reported alongside.
